itens.trecho: "The Eternaut" is a series based on the iconic Argentine comic work El Eternauta, created by Héctor Germán Oesterheld. The Netflix series, like the comic its based upon, follows the premise of a end of the world alien invasion in Buenos Aires, Argentina. So is it any good? The answer is mostly, yes.
Great show. I love movies and shows about post-apocalyptic, dystopian themes and this one is definitely a very good one. Highly recommended. No DEI and propaganda BS, by the way.
